pr_body:
# What does this PR do?

Fixes #35432 

The docstring of `SequenceBiasLogitsProcessor` was outdated -- the example didn't work with fast tokenizers, and fast tokenizers are now the norm. This PR updates the example and tips, especially to be used with fast tokenizers.
pr_comments: The docs for this PR live [here](https://moon-ci-docs.huggingface.co/docs/transformers/pr_35699). All of your documentation changes will be reflected on that endpoint. The docs are available until 30 days after the last update.

issue_context.title: apply class transformers.SequenceBiasLogitsProcessor on Qwen model
issue_context.body:
### Feature request

I notice that your wrote:
In order to get the token ids of the sequences that you want to bias, make sure to set add_prefix_space=True when initializing the tokenizer, and use tokenizer(bad_words, add_special_tokens=False).input_ids. The add_prefix_space argument is only supported for some slow tokenizers, as fast tokenizers’ prefixing behaviours come from pre tokenizers. Read more [here](https://huggingface.co/docs/tokenizers/api/pre-tokenizers).



So if I am using Qwen model, since its tokenizer is based on fast tokenizers, I can't use this bias logits feature?

Is there anyway I can use the Qwen model and still use this feature?

### Motivation

the old code is not working on the new model like qwen, want update.

### Your contribution

none
comments: any idea on if this feature can get updated?
I wrote that a long ago :D I'm going to revisit it to see if we still have the same limitation with fast tokenizers.

@buptspig @panguagency 

the docstring was indeed outdated :) check #35699 for the updated docstring, which includes an example with a fast tokenizer (qwen)
@gante   thanks a lot, I will check now, glad that I can use this feature!

@panguagency it can probably be improved, but we're low on bandwidth (contributions are welcome!). Currently, it has a for loop, applying one bias at a time, but the code can probably be vectorized with torch operations.
